tools.name: create_poker_table
tools.description: Create a real free Omaha Hi-Lo table for bot practice or friends. Return its join link; the human plays on the website. First human to join becomes host. Never place bets or play for the user.

tools.name: get_play_link
tools.description: Prepare a NEW playable table and return its join link. Supports bots or friends. Reuse a previously returned link instead of calling again when possible.

tools.name: get_game_info
tools.description: Explain Omaha Hi-Lo rules, free guest play, supported features and website links.

tools.name: get_table_status
tools.description: Read only existence, waiting/in-progress state and available seats. Never returns names, credentials, invitations or cards.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_table_status" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Read only existence, waiting/in-progress state and available seats. Never returns names, credentials, invitations or cards.
